summary: Ran a fresh isolated Google Chrome context against the assigned local archive. No page errors occurred and no order, payment, message, business form or cart mutation was submitted. The lower description control works: aria-expanded changes from false to true and content height from 380 to 412.859375 px. The introduction, filtering, sorting, pagination and quantity-to-cart interactions are missing or inert.
issues: PA-INT-001 [P1] introduction expand: expected sourced expandable introduction content; actual copyCount is 0 and the sole button has hidden=true. Fix: render the source content and a working accessible expand state.

PA-INT-002 [P1] filters: expected native functional filters; actual 20 of 20 checkboxes are disabled, categoryLinkCount is 0, the producer group has no interactive element, price inputs are disabled, and the 390 px view has no visible filter trigger. Fix: connect controls to real WooCommerce filtering and accessible UI states.

PA-INT-003 [P1] sort/pagination: expected native sorting and page navigation; actual sort has zero selects or other interactive elements, while pagination has seven spans and zero links/buttons. Fix: use real WooCommerce controls with keyboard-operable semantics.

PA-INT-004 [P1] quantity integration: expected changing quantity to 2 to update the add-to-cart request; actual input changes to 2 while href remains https://autopilot.local/kategoria-produktu/fungicydy/?add-to-cart=143 with no quantity. Fix: bind the quantity control to the native cart request.
